query: Rice production trends in Senegal over the last 5 years, with production volumes in tonnes
synthesis:
Rice production in Senegal has recently undergone a major statistical realignment. In the 2024/25 marketing year (MY), the Government of Senegal (GOS) implemented a new statistical reference base to provide more reliable agricultural data, which resulted in a reported 42% decline in production volumes compared to previous methodologies [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual 2025 - Rice Production Trends](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008).

### Production Volumes (in Metric Tons - MT)
Based on the latest available reporting, annual production volumes for rough (paddy) and milled rice are as follows:
- **MY 2025/26 (Forecast):** 949,000 MT rough rice (645,000 MT milled) [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual 2025 - Rice Production Trends](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008).
- **MY 2024/25 (Estimate):** 882,000 MT rough rice (600,000 MT milled). This figure reflects the new statistical base [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual 2025 - Rice Production Trends](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008).
- **MY 2023/24 (Actual):** 1,525,000 MT rough rice (1,037,000 MT milled). This figure follows the old statistical methodology [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual 2025 - Rice Production Trends](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008).
- **MY 2022/23 (Actual):** 1,406,000 MT rough rice (956,000 MT milled) [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual Report 2024](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2024-0004.pdf).
- **Historical Average (2018–2022):** 1,300,656 MT annually [Rice (ORYZA SATIVA) Market Intelligence Report NAB 2025-002](https://www.nab.com.na/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Rice-ORYZA-SATIVA-Market-Intelligence-Report-NAB-2025-002.pdf).

### Key Regional Trends
Production has shifted geographically, with the South (Kolda, Ziguinchor, and Sedhiou) now accounting for approximately 62% of total production [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual 2025 - Rice Production Trends](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008). Northern production in the Senegal River Valley (SRV) remains stable but faces challenges such as bird pressure and high input costs [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual Report 2024](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2024-0004.pdf). Yields vary significantly by region, with northern irrigated systems reaching 6 MT/HA during the dry season, compared to 2.0 to 3.5 MT/HA in the south [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual 2025 - Rice Production Trends](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008).

### Factors Influencing Production
1. **Subsidies:** The GOS heavily subsidizes seeds (up to 90%) and fertilizers to boost output. Farm gate prices have also increased by 23% since 2022 [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual 2025 - Rice Production Trends](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008).
2. **Environmental Constraints:** In 2024/25, flooding caused the loss of 2,800 hectares in the Bakel, Matam, and Podor regions [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual 2025 - Rice Production Trends](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2025-0008). 
3. **Pests:** The sector is regularly impacted by rice-eating birds in the Delta and armyworms in the Casamance region [Senegal Grain and Feed Annual Report 2024](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Grain%20and%20Feed%20Annual_Dakar_Senegal_SG2024-0004.pdf).

### Data Gaps and Contradictions
There is a notable contradiction between sources regarding 2024/25 production. One source cites nearly 1.5 million MT [Senegal’s rice production growth fails to curb rising import dependence](https://infoarroz.org/blog/2025/09/16/senegals-rice-production-growth-fails-to-curb-rising-import-dependence/), while the more recent USDA report (2025) estimates only 882,000 MT due to the aforementioned methodology change. The available sources did not contain specific annual figures for the individual years 2020 or 2021 outside of multi-year averages.
